standard.coverage: Employers with SIX OR MORE non-exempt employees at any one separate, distinct and permanent work location (W. Va. Code 21-5C-1). An employer under that threshold owes only the federal $7.25.

tipped.note: West Virginia allows the largest tip credit as a PERCENTAGE of any state -- 70% of the minimum wage.

youthAndTraining.label: Federal youth opportunity wage
youthAndTraining.eligibility: Employees under 20, first 90 consecutive calendar days -- 29 U.S.C. 206(g). Not a state figure; carried here because it is the only sub-minimum wage available in this state.

knownGaps: This engine's garnishment data (data/garnishment/state-overrides-2026.json) deliberately uses the FEDERAL $7.25 for West Virginia's 30x floor, because W. Va. Code 38-5A-3 names the federal minimum wage specifically -- not this $8.75 state rate. The two files disagree on purpose.
